newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones rose 10.77 points to 6,843.87. PLDT's ADR fell $1 3/8 to $57 1/8.
* On Monday, the peso weakened to 26.312 to a U.S. dollar from 26.311.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,280.85, down 13.46.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady at 10.53215 percent.

* Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc says it will go to court if the contract signed by its subsidiary Amari Coastal Bay Development Corp with the state-owned Public Estate Authority is rescinded. (PHILIPPINE JOURNAL)
* Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc wants a higher stake in Pepsi Cola Products Philippiens Inc by buying the 30 percent stake of PepsiCo Inc. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)
* A. Soriano Corp needs 22 billion pesos to build up its equity base in the next five years, All Asia Securities Corp says. (MANILA TIMES)
* Globe Telecom GMCR will raise 1.6 billion pesos through a stock rights offer scheduled next month involving the sale of 133,333,333 shares at 12 pesos per share. (BUSINESSWORLD)
* Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc announces that it has installed a total of 134,620 additional lines under its roll out programme for the year 1996.
